explication: Hermes Mobile is an Android companion for controlling a Hermes Agent through its dashboard’s REST API and WebSocket gateway. The main workflow is to configure a connection, authenticate, enter the app, and use chat or other agent-management features; chat can receive live events, while local storage supports history and settings. The README also documents operations, configuration, productivity, analytics/billing, and launcher shortcuts, so these appear as distinct capability branches. Several UI and feature implementations are unsampled; their links are shown only where the README or source index supports them.
